decision.observation: Reverse worked: 4 mph in gear R, all dots pale. The car has backed away from the fence onto the grass strip beside it; its tail now points down-frame toward the wide gravel road that runs across the lower half of the frame.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing straight reverse should carry the tail onto the gravel; once on it, a forward W beat with steer can point the nose along the road rather than back at the fence.
decision.memory: S-only from the fence pin delivered 4 mph and clear separation from the rail. Grass reverse is slow but the gravel is only a couple of car lengths behind here.
